description: Source code for a NestJS controller managing API endpoints related to atom schedules, including CRUD operations and schedule duplication.

classes.name: AtomsSchedulesController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling API endpoints for atom schedules, including retrieval, creation, update, and duplication of schedules.

methods.name: getSchedule
methods.description: Fetches a specific schedule based on query parameters, including schedule ID and event type.

methods.name: getScheduleByEventSlug
methods.description: Retrieves a schedule by its associated event slug.

methods.name: getAllUserSchedules
methods.description: Retrieves all schedules associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: updateSchedule
methods.description: Updates an existing schedule identified by schedule ID.

methods.name: createSchedule
methods.description: Creates a new schedule based on provided data.

methods.name: duplicateExistingSchedule
methods.description: Duplicates an existing schedule by schedule ID.
